		limit = { sg_law_available_law_autocracy = yes NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes } }
		start_enactment = law_type:law_autocracy
	}
	# Rerank even when the guard failed: the row is stale and must
	# disappear or change instead of looking like a dead click.
	sg_rank_laws = yes
}

sg_ignore_law_law_autocracy = {
	set_variable = { name = sg_ignored_selected value = 6 }
	sg_store_ignored_selected = yes
	remove_variable = sg_ignored_selected
	sg_rank_laws = yes
}
